concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-account-structure-resources-legal-entity-management]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace LEM resource orientation for user legal entities, transfer instruments and supporting documents as verification inputs before payment, payout or financial-product capabilities.
warnings: Creation or submission of LEM resources is information provision, not proof that verification passed or payment, payout or optional financial products are enabled.
The description of a transfer instrument as a verified bank account does not prove that a specific newly created instrument has completed bank verification.
